items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: I think it's, uh, Kid Thomas, I think, plays the horn very much like Mutt.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about Mutt's vibrato?

Uh, I know, it was quite, uh, I don't know how he, uh, got it. Uh, I think it's, uh, Kid Thomas, I think, plays the horn very much like Mutt. I think, physically, I think they approach the horn, the production of tone the same way. And the vibrato, I think, is, is, uh, to me seems to be the same kind of vibrato.
Oh, ooh. Was, did you say Mutt was fast or slow?
